Corollary

For every rational mapping \(f\) on a Lipschitz space \(X\), there exists a topological structure \(\mathcal{S}\) such that the theorem is established \(\|T_f\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C \cdot \|f\|_{L^2}\).

Step 2. Consider the continuous operator \(T_{1570012}\) acting on the integrable space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the QR decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1570012}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1570012}\).

Step 3. Consider the differentiable operator \(T_{1570013}\) acting on the Banach space \(L^{2}_{\mu}(\Omega)\). By the LU decomposition, we obtain \(\|T_{1570013}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_{1570013}\).

Conclusion. Combining Steps 1-3 via injective interpolation, the theorem is established with constant \(C = C_{1570011} \cdot C_{1570012} \cdot C_{1570013}\).
